title: Twitter Performance Analysis - Jan 1st - Feb 28th 2023
body:

Below is a Running Report for our 2023 Social Media Communications.

For 2023..
Our 2 month overall Engagement Rate% is currently  _**3.42%**_
1. Tweets related to our _Operations_, currently leads our Average _Engagement rate at **4.0%**_
2. Tweets related to our _Operations,_ currently leads all categories...
